title: DAILY SAVE BACKUPS
why: His Tech answer of 2026-10-12 asks for an automatic daily save backup. Keep three raw dated copies per save slot and reuse the Settings restore row and undo.
now: Each career save keeps up to three daily copies. Settings restores a daily copy or a file with undo. Full storage quietly skips copies and leaves room for the main save.
